entities.name: Juš Kozak
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Juš Kozak, also known under the pseudonym Jalanov, was a Slovenian writer, playwright, and editor. He is best known for his autobiographic novels, such as Celica on his experience as a political prisoner, and Lesena žlica on life during World War II.
